quote_original: The first letter, JOD in the name GOD is a hand or a seed, not just a hand, but the hand of the director.
context_before: ey said that God’s name was spelled, JOD HE VAU HE. I shall take these symbols and in our normal, down to earth language, explain them in this manner.
context_after: If there is one organ of man that discriminates and sets him apart from the entire world of creation it is his hand. What we call a hand in the anthropoid ape is not a hand. rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: But there is a SHIN, or flame, within the name of the Son, which allows that Son to become detached from states He formerly expressed within the world.
context_before: A tooth is that which consumes, that which devours. I must have within me the power to consume that which I now dislike. I, in my ignorance, brought to birth certain things I now dislike and would like to leave behind me. Were there not within me the flames that would consume it, I would be condemned forever to live in a world of all my mistakes.
context_after: Man is incapable of seeing other than the contents of his own consciousness.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 1 – Consciousness Is The Only Reality (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
source_title: Lesson 1 – Consciousness Is The Only Reality

quote_original: It is the SHIN, or a tooth, in the Son’s name that gives him absolute dominion.
context_before: ious of it. There is something in me that devours it within me. It can only live within my objective world if I keep it alive within my consciousness.
context_after: Why could it not have been in the Father’s name? For this simple reason: Nothing can cease to be in the Father. Even the unlovely things cannot cease to be. If I once give it expression, forever and ever it remains locked within the dimensionally greater Self which is the Father. But I would not like to keep alive within my world all of my mistakes. So I, in my infinite mercy gave to myself, when I became man, the power to become detached from these things that I, in my ignorance, brought to birth in my world..
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 1 – Consciousness Is The Only Reality (1968-01-01).

quote_original: Do not become distressed in our practical approach to it, for as you sit here you, too, are Isaac.

author: Neville Goddard
source_title: Lesson 1 – Consciousness Is The Only Reality
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: For ten years I was a dancer, dancing in Broadway shows, in vaudeville, night clubs, and in Europe.
context_before: must be someone in this room who will so completely transform himself in this world that his close immediate circle of friends will not recognize him.
context_after: There was a time in my life when I thought I could not live without certain friends in my world. I would spread a table every night after the theatre and we would all dine well. I thought I could never live without them. Now I confess I could not live with them. We have nothing in common today. When we meet we do not purposely walk on the opposite side of the street, but it is almost a cold meeting because we have nothing to discuss. I so died to that life that as I meet these people they cannot even talk of the old times.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 1 – Consciousness Is The Only Reality (1968-01-01).

quote_original: I would spread a table every night after the theatre and we would all dine well. I thought I could never live without them. Now I confess I could not live with them.
context_before: For ten years I was a dancer, dancing in Broadway shows, in vaudeville, night clubs, and in Europe. There was a time in my life when I thought I could not live without certain friends in my world.
context_after: We have nothing in common today. When we meet we do not purposely walk on the opposite side of the street, but it is almost a cold meeting because we have nothing to discuss. I so died to that life that as I meet these people they cannot even talk of the old times.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Lesson 1 – Consciousness Is The Only Reality (1968-01-01).
